answer: Because the lagoon stake is held until the pigment settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the haven audit lists each exposure. A farm running 188 keys hence pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. An attester must stake 34% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
